repository.name: HA-Energy-Price-Engine
repository.description: A modular Home Assistant integration that automatically retrieves, calculates and stores complete electricity prices, including spot prices, grid tariffs, supplier fees, taxes and VAT. Provides persistent 15-minute price data for EV charging, heating, battery storage and smart energy automation.

release.name: Energy Price Engine v1.1.0-beta.1 — automatic card setup and display units
release.body:
# Energy Price Engine v1.1.0-beta.1 — Issue20

PE remains a single HACS integration. The bundled Lovelace card now registers its
versioned module automatically through HA's native storage-resource collection,
including cold startup before any dashboard visit. A single old manual PE URL is
adopted in place; unrelated resources and their order remain. Repeated startup/site
reload does not duplicate it. Ambiguous duplicate paths are reported without edits.
YAML resources stay user-managed, with precise instructions. Registration errors log
an action and leave the pricing engine operational.

Each card accepts optional `unit: ore_kwh` (default, two decimals) or `unit: dkk_kwh`
(four decimals). Full-precision frontend values are converted only at presentation.
Graphs, axes, tooltips, statistics, tariffs, breakdowns and every quarter use that
unit. Cards preserve independent selection and share concurrent authenticated reads.
Changing units does not request backend data. The saved VAT preference is retained.

```yaml
type: vertical-stack
cards:
  - type: custom:energy-price-engine-card
    unit: ore_kwh
  - type: custom:energy-price-engine-card
    unit: dkk_kwh
```

Optional `site_id` selects an existing site. [Full example](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v1.1.0-beta.1/docs/dashboard.yaml) ·
[Resource registration, YAML fallback and troubleshooting](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v1.1.0-beta.1/docs/PRICE_DASHBOARD.md).

The actual v1.0.0 engine/API v2, SQLite schema/history/revisions, tariff/source code,
sensors, site IDs and configuration are preserved. Dashboard data-producing functions
are unchanged; only native setup registers the optional module. Today+tomorrow,
92/96/100-quarter DST days, negative prices, readiness gaps and VAT semantics remain.
No new price sensors, controls, provider or contract defaults are introduced.

## Validation and release scope

Automated tests cover native collections, cold loading, adoption/order, concurrency,
YAML, ambiguous duplicates, pricing startup on resource failure and multi-site reload.
Browser tests cover paired units in EN/DA, desktop/tablet/mobile, full source precision,
negative/near-zero values, missing windows, DST and VAT projection. Actual pinned HACS
checks stable default versus explicit beta visibility/selection, upgrade/install,
reinstall/uninstall and persistence. Both package layouts are tested outside source.
Native disposable HA checks fresh cold load, public v1.0.0 upgrade, retained sites and
IDs/SQLite bytes, native resource loading, paired cards and restart. Exact outcomes
and source hashes are recorded in the [handoff](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v1.1.0-beta.1/docs/DEVELOPMENT_STATUS.md) and
[native receipt](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v1.1.0-beta.1/docs/receipts/v1.1.0-beta.1-simulation.json).

For HACS testing, enable **Show beta versions**, explicitly select **v1.1.0-beta.1**,
download, restart HA and reload the browser/app. Keep existing sites and history.
Storage resources update automatically; YAML resources need the versioned URL shown
in the dashboard guide. Uninstalling one site does not remove a global resource;
after complete PE uninstall the owner can remove only the orphan PE module in HA UI.

This is an opt-in prerelease on a dedicated reviewable branch/PR. Main stays at
v1.0.0 and v1.0.0 remains latest stable. Publication requires normal review/security,
exact-source push/PR/tag CI, clean reproducibility, immutable annotation and all prior
release/tag/asset integrity checks. Fresh public jobs independently verify actual
metadata/downloads, stable and beta HACS channels and both native ZIP layouts.

Owner PAHA02-DEV visual acceptance remains separate and required before any future
stable promotion. These recorded/synthetic tests establish neither provider uptime
nor Raspberry Pi performance. No production HA, Node-RED, CM or charging control
was changed. No main merge or v1.1 stable publication is part of this mission.

latest_stable.name: Energy Price Engine v1.0.0 — Stable
latest_stable.body:
# Energy Price Engine v1.0.0 — Stable

The first stable release promotes the owner-accepted published beta.12 MVP from
`e506ccfc40b61413bd83e3ce60081a60d517348f`. Product version is **1.0.0**; the documented
read-only producer contract remains **API v2**. PE works independently of CM.

This is a stabilization release. All22 runtime Python modules, the pricing model,
source adapters, SQLite schema/revisions, scheduler, entity identities, configuration
behavior and card JavaScript remain byte-identical beta.12. Runtime changes are
version metadata and neutral reset translations. No reset or repricing is introduced.

Official Nord Pool/DK1/DK2, verified Radius C, dated national charges, actual private
markup, VAT Yes/No, every native Diagnostic, 15-minute negative prices/DST, today and
tomorrow schedules, durable history and API2 readiness are retained. Primary sensor
Recorder basis stays fixed and labeled; Diagnostics/card follow the VAT preference,
while actual VAT amount stays unchanged. No invoice/subscription/control features.

## Install or update

Add the GitHub custom repository in HACS as an Integration, leave **Show beta versions
off**, download **v1.0.0** and restart HA. Existing beta.12 sites, entity IDs, rates,
VAT choices and SQLite history remain. Reload browser/app/card resources; use
`/ha_energy_price_engine/energy-price-engine-card.js?v=1.0.0`.

[Installation guide](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v1.0.0/docs/HACS_DISTRIBUTION.md) · [Native Diagnostics](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v1.0.0/docs/DIAGNOSTICS.md) ·
[Dashboard](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v1.0.0/docs/PRICE_DASHBOARD.md) · [Stable API2](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v1.0.0/docs/API.md) · [Acceptance](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v1.0.0/docs/ACCEPTANCE.md).

## Release gates and provenance

The exact published beta.12 source is frozen as the baseline. Clean release branch
and review PR target main; normal repository approvals/protection are respected.
Pre-merge CI, recorded/native beta.12 upgrade and clean install evidence, actual-main
CI, immutable tag, reproducible packages and prior-release preservation are required.
Stable publication is non-prerelease/latest and is independently verified with public
source/assets, SHA256, actual HACS stable selection and both native package layouts.
Exact results/source/checksums are recorded by the permanent handoff and release receipt.

The supported/current matrix is HA2026.10.3/.4. Tests use recorded public and fictional
private inputs, real HA lifecycle/HTTP/flows, actual pinned HACS with GitHub transport
fixtures, and real SQLite disk recovery. Disposable native browser QA is separate from
owner live/Pi acceptance. No public-provider uptime or hardware performance is inferred.

Native HA2026.10.4 evidence includes30 hashed desktop/mobile EN/DA screenshots, fresh
manual setup and an upgrade from the hash-verified actual published beta.12 HACS ZIP.
All69 existing entity IDs, three effective site settings/mixed VAT preferences and
both SQLite ledger files survived update and restart. A fresh site also retained its
23 entities, No VAT display preference and inclusive-source supplier rate after restart.
[Native evidence](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v1.0.0/docs/receipts/v1.0.0-simulation.json).

## Known limits

Private supplier terms must be configured and verified by the site owner. Bundled
national charges have actual expiry dates; no later rates are invented. Legacy custom
Nordpool must not shadow the official domain. History uses storage/RAM proportional to
retention; cloud benchmarks do not establish Pi performance. CM's unreleased API-v1
consumer needs its own migration. Separate HACS catalog and external brands submissions
remain owner actions; a custom-repository stable release is not catalog admission.
[Compatibility and troubleshooting](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v1.0.0/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md).

Publication does not authorize production HA changes, Node-RED changes, EV commands
or a CM charging cutover. Stop after verified v1.0.0 publication for owner verification.

releases.name: v0.1.0-beta.12 — choose VAT display and preserve native Diagnostics
releases.body:
# v0.1.0-beta.12 — choose VAT display without changing price history

Initial setup now includes **Including VAT?**, default Yes. Existing beta.11 sites
also default Yes without reset. Change it later in normal **Configure → Including VAT**.
The saved strictly boolean preference appears as an enabled native Diagnostic row,
**Including VAT — Yes/No**, localized **Inklusive moms — Ja/Nej**.

Every approved beta.11 Diagnostic remains: current/next verified quarter, eight price
components including VAT amount/final, four actual grid ranges and Status. A normal
four-band site has 15 Diagnostic rows / 23 entities. All monetary rows default to
øre/kWh, two decimals, in the selected basis. Six component values use the same stored
quarter's `incl_vat` or `ex_vat`. Ex-VAT final sums its unrounded stored components.
**VAT amount remains the actual stored tax amount in both modes**; it is informational
in No mode. No blind 1.25 conversion, double VAT, mixed quarters or invented zeroes.
Grid bands use verified cached components and retain real local ranges/DST.

The nine primary sensor values/state classes retain their previous fixed VAT basis
for Recorder safety, now explicitly labeled. The card follows the preference for
components, final graph, statistics and tariffs; its separate raw Nord Pool graph
stays clearly ex VAT. Internal dashboard schema3 requires reloading cached browser
resources. The Python CM API stays v2 with canonical VAT-inclusive final values.

Display-only saves notify entities without integration reload, acquisition, canonical
calculation, SQLite writes or price revisions. Price model, ledger schema, adapters,
scheduler, readiness and consumer API are preserved. All original IDs and dated rules
remain; contract rate-input `vat_included` remains a separate source convention.

## HACS update

1. Back up development HA. Enable **Show beta versions**, refresh information,
   select **v0.1.0-beta.12**, download and restart HA.
2. Reload the browser/app and cached card resource. Keep beta.10/11 sites and history;
   **no reset is needed**. Older incompatible beta1–9 sites have a separate reset guide.
3. Verify Device info 0.1.0-beta.12, then open the native device Diagnostic section.
   Toggle Yes/No through Configure and confirm all components/grid bands follow it,
   while VAT amount stays unchanged. Reopen Configure/restart to verify persistence.

[Setup guide](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.12/docs/HACS_DISTRIBUTION.md) · [Diagnostics](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.12/docs/DIAGNOSTICS.md) ·

interruption/restart, unchanged API/ledger bytes/primary state classes, current/next,
mixed VAT rates/already-inclusive inputs, negative prices, missing inputs and DST.

releases.name: v0.1.0-beta.11 — restore native Device Diagnostics and actual Radius periods
releases.body:
# v0.1.0-beta.11 — restore native Device Diagnostics

Beta.11 corrects the beta.10 regression reported in #16: price components were
available in attributes/card data but missing from the native device Diagnostic
section. Every essential calculation value is visible again as an enabled entity.
A dashboard is not required.

Open **Settings → Devices & services → Energy Price Engine → device → Diagnostic**:

- **Current quarter** or **Next verified quarter**, with its local clock range.
- **Nord Pool spot, applied DSO, Energinet network/system, supplier markup and
  electricity tax**, excluding VAT.
- **VAT amount** and **verified final price**, including VAT once in the total.
- **Four actual Radius day ranges and rates**, independent of final-price history.
- **Status**, reusing the existing availability entity with readiness/corrective guidance.

All numeric amounts default to **øre/kWh, two decimals**. The eight component rows
come from one verified stored record/revision. When current final is Unknown but
next is READY, every diagnostic amount belongs to the explicitly labeled next
quarter; independently current spot/DSO sensors keep their current values. At the
boundary the breakdown switches automatically. Missing values stay Unknown, never
zero. Equal-price separate grid bands remain separate. Different/fewer/more ranges
are shown truthfully; additional actual bands receive enabled rows.

## HACS update from beta.10

1. Back up development HA. In HACS, keep **Show beta versions** enabled, refresh,
   select **v0.1.0-beta.11**, download and restart HA. Reload the app/browser.
2. **Keep existing sites. No beta.10 reset or reconfiguration is required.** Verify
   **Device info → 0.1.0-beta.11** and the 14 Diagnostic rows on a four-band site.
   The nine original entities remain, with their existing IDs and user settings;
   13 purposeful additional diagnostic entities bring the normal total to22.
3. Confirm the selected current/next period, actual supplier markup, applied DSO,
   all four day ranges, VAT and final. Old beta1–9 installations still need the
   explicit older-schema procedure in the setup guide; do not reset a beta.10 site.

[Native Diagnostic guide/screenshots](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.11/docs/DIAGNOSTICS.md) ·
[Complete HACS installation procedure](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.11/docs/HACS_DISTRIBUTION.md) ·
[Owner acceptance checklist](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.11/docs/BETA_ACCEPTANCE.md) · [API2 contract](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.11/docs/API.md).

## Verification

**123 tests per core**, HA2026.10.3 and current2026.10.4, **90% coverage**, zero skips;
18 existing card browser regressions; official hassfest/HACS/Ruff/package CI.
Cases cover coherent current/next values, the owner-shaped287.42 example with
explicitly fictional private rates, automatic switching, mixed VAT/negative prices,
missing/stale sources, midnight next-day DSO, seasonal/DST ranges and live extra-band
creation/removal from the applicable schedule.

A disposable native HA.4 installation was loaded from the downloaded, SHA-verified
published beta.10 package, then upgraded to the candidate. All27 original entity IDs
